headline: Built for teams that ship
subheadline: Every feature ties back to one thing: getting code into production faster, with fewer surprises.

features.title: Atomic preview deploys
features.description: Every PR gets a unique URL with a real environment. Reviewers click, not clone.

features.title: Rollback in one click
features.description: Atomic deploys mean every release is reversible. Bad deploy at 2am? Six seconds to safe.

features.title: Edge-first by default
features.description: Static assets cached at 300+ POPs. Dynamic routes run on workers — no cold starts.

features.title: Drop-in CDN
features.description: Point your domain, get TLS, HTTP/3, and Brotli automatically. No nginx tuning required.

features.title: Observability built in
features.description: Request logs, real-user metrics, and error traces — no separate Datadog setup.

features.title: Support that ships
features.description: Real engineers, real responses. SLAs include actual response times, not portal acknowledgement.
